title: 美瞳线：黑色与棕色怎么选
intro: 美瞳线做出来好不好看，不只是“选黑色还是选棕色”二选一。眼型大小、双眼皮褶宽窄和眼尾高低，共同决定了线条要放多细、落在什么位置。
intro_en: Lash-line enhancement is more than picking black or brown ink. Eye shape, eyelid crease width and outer-corner angle decide both pigment shade and line thickness.

sections.title: 黑色 vs 棕色：按日常素颜频率与瞳色选择
sections.title_en: Black vs brown: matching bare-skin habits and iris tone
sections.description: 黑色存在感更清楚，适合日常希望眼神轮廓明显一点、平时也会画轻微眼妆或本身瞳色乌黑的人群；棕色（支持按需求选色）视觉更轻盈柔和，线条嵌在睫毛根部不容易有生硬“画了一条线”的对比感，平时几乎全素颜、浅棕发色或眼皮较薄的朋友往往更偏爱棕色方向。
sections.description_en: Black creates stronger lash-root contrast, often chosen by clients with dark irises who enjoy clear eye framing. Brown—one of our available colour options—gives a gentler blend along the roots that suits frequent bare-skin wear, lighter hair or delicate lids.

sections.title: 乐乐老师面诊眼部的四个真实观察维度
sections.title_en: Four eye-shape observations checked during consultation
sections.description: 设计美瞳线时，乐乐老师会结合四个具体观察去调粗细和位置：第一看眼睛形状与整体大小，第二看双眼皮褶的宽窄（内双、窄双或宽平行双能露出的线条宽度不同），第三看眼尾高低走势，第四看左右眼对称度。比如遇到露眼白稍微多一点的眼型，设计思路会考虑做得贴近里面一点，在视觉上起到适当收束提亮眼神的协调作用，也可以通过微调线条粗细来平衡左右视觉高低感。
sections.description_en: During assessment, Lele inspects eye shape and scale, lid-crease width (hooded, narrow or wider double eyelids), outer-corner tilt and left-right balance. Where more sclera shows, placing a fine line cleanly along the inner lash margin helps frame the eye visually, while subtle thickness tuning can help balance perceived asymmetry.

sections.title: 只做眼部轮廓修饰：不画大外翘眼线，不做医疗承诺
sections.title_en: Subtle lash-line framing without exaggerated wings
sections.description: 美瞳线主打贴近睫毛根部的内眼线视觉修饰，追求睁眼有神、闭眼不突兀，不建议盲目做又粗又长的外挑飞尾（因为眼周肌肤随年龄和妆容流行会变化）。本说明仅介绍乐乐老师的视觉设计考虑，不延伸为固定效果保证或医学结论。
sections.description_en: Lash-line work focuses cleanly on the root zone—refined with eyes open and understated when closed—avoiding thick, trendy winged extensions that age awkwardly. Aesthetic goals vary individually and are never framed as medical claims or uniform guarantees.

sections.title: 没有尴尬期，可当天正常洗脸化妆与一年内补色
sections.title_en: No awkward recovery phase, same-day washing and one-year touch-up
sections.description: 美瞳线属于仪器类项目，在描眉画目定位为没有尴尬期，通常操作后当天不影响正常洗脸等日常清洁，具体细节仍会按当次实际操作状态嘱咐，不作所有人体质全无反应的绝对保证。门店同样提供黑/棕颜色选做沟通，并在操作后享有一年内免费补色。
sections.description_en: As an instrument service, lash-line enhancement avoids an awkward heavy-flaking phase and generally allows normal face washing the same day, with tailored care notes confirmed at your visit. Colour options and free touch-ups within one year are included.
